scope: Review follow-up validation; earlier runtime and benchmark results remain separate historical evidence.
sanitization: Only allowlisted scalar aggregates and fixed source/test labels. Raw reports, signed bytes, transaction identities, endpoints, credentials, and local process paths remain private.
review_changes: Separate bounded unscoped health lane; explicit chain scope for all account-abstraction process handlers.
Reclaim only idle EVM lanes; retain fallback while any overflow holder or waiter remains.
Reject owned-operation registration with retryable Busy behind a drain writer instead of waiting while holding a lane.
Register the common journal, queue, and executor collectors before startup work.
Limit Solana status batches to 32 signatures; validate each response position independently; provide a default-enabled batching opt-out.
Clarify operator recovery and EOA continuity retry documentation without adding automatic reconstruction.

full_rust_suite.count_note: 47 journal + 73 executor + 4 admission + 3 HTTP API + 36 queue tests; workspace results and nested subprocess output are not added again.
full_rust_suite.redis_durability: Disposable Redis AOF every second; not an AOF-always stress qualification.

focused_formal.scope: Projection-focused subset on the preceding revision; full final-head formal results are recorded separately. Finite protocol models and source guards do not prove Rust refinement or fair scheduling.

prior_evidence.scope_note: Earlier 32 TPS finite-run pass and crash recovery, strict capacity unconfirmed; 40 TPS longer-run failure retained. The earlier 256-signature batch cap differs from this revision with a 32-signature cap.

shutdown_followup.finding: A caller waiting before owned registration could acquire a registration guard after the reusable drain writer returned.
shutdown_followup.fix: A permanent closed flag under the same registration lock rejects late callers after server shutdown close, while already owned repairs finish.
shutdown_followup.independent_review: No blocker found; both registration and closed-state observation use the same read guard. The writer waits for prior readers before latching closed.
regressions: Canceled owned acknowledgement keeps close waiting until repair completes.
Detached health callers released after close from either lane or capacity waits cannot repair or alter the checkpoint.
Close remains permanent through repeated barriers; a newly opened journal can operate.

final_focused_formal.scope: Focused projection subset at the final revision; separate from full final-head formal CI.

review_dispositions.topic: Unscoped health and AA chain identity
review_dispositions.evidence: Bounded unscoped health tests and explicit scopes in all four AA handlers; no per-chain ingress reservation.
Idle reclamation preserves holder and queued-waiter references; live overflow prevents a split lane.
Nonblocking registration and permanent close; dedicated/overflow drain inversion and late lane/capacity probes tested.
One exported registry is installed before journal, queue and executor startup; the final campaign contains journal and executor timing observations.
Individual invalid positions fail independently; shared envelope and length failures still fail the batch.

review_dispositions.topic: Slow archival lookup in a batch
review_dispositions.evidence: 32-signature cap, default-enabled opt-out, bounded transport and 11 HTTP fixtures. No production archival provider is qualified by these local runs.

A Redis process restart with any unacknowledged transition requires fresh-namespace recovery and quarantine even when the target marker survives. Intact idle reattach evidence does not cover pending-under-load recovery.
One-way schema migration, retained unknown outcomes, two-second publication retry and ten-second other EOA continuity retry. No signed-attempt reconstruction or in-place downgrade.
